findings: Reviewed immutable tip 49388ae279407335f6047636d312181b0c8c22cd. Its only change from parent production commit bdd66c285237ae7c921400a1807268abba73c54b is the mandatory decimal-literal ratchet from 1050 to 1053 in plantuml_metrics.rs's baseline; it contains no production source. The 49388ae2 decimal guard passes. The reviewer separately inspected the full bdd66c28 production diff against the causal account at 504164a6c6d4c364506525d0da28ec8529ca66df and its prior correction f07599fb206313af770b9eb3e35cd4a6254716aa.

Rejected: Java SvekNode chooses the special entry/exit HTML port path only when (int) label width is greater than 40. Rust instead checks the untruncated floating measurement against 40.0 in both state_position_image_offset_x and add_svek_state_border_node_with_label. In the preserved threshold case, WWWJ measures about 40.2842px: Java truncates it to 40 and emits a basic rectangle; Rust emits the shield. Java -debugsvek shows that rectangle beside WWWf, which truncates to 41 and emits the HTML table. The resulting Rust diagram is 9px taller and shifts downstream solved geometry. This is a concrete causal counterexample to the account's model.

Rejected: even above the threshold, Java SvekNode supplies Graphviz a three-row plaintext HTML table whose middle cell is the fixed 12px P port and whose full-width rows use int(labelWidth)-40. Rust replaces that layout contract with NodeShape::SvekStateBorderShield and a custom rustuml_center_port in vendored shapes.c. The long independently renamed entry and exit labels preserve valid Java syntax but differ in node x positions and edge routing. Java -debugsvek reports 135px and 130px table widths; the Rust synthetic port does not represent those solver constraints. The mismatch is geometry-model coupling, not paint-only drift.

The original nine held-outs all pass at the immutable 49388ae2 archive, including ordinary/group styles, matching and nonmatching selectors, explicit fill/stroke precedence, deepHistory case behavior, non-normal positions, nested/concurrent topology, and selector-named composites. Fresh outputPin/expansionOutput, short entry/exit labels, described autonomous leaves with independently varied attribute typography, and exact/numeric/invalid font-face controls also pass. These gains do not falsify the two port-model failures.

All fifteen sources are valid Java diagrams, have paired Java SVGs that are well-formed and contain no PlantUML error page, and are source-unique against the golden corpus. The two failing fresh pairs remain checked in as executable counterexamples; no baseline, comparator, park list, error-golden marker, account, or production source was changed by this review.

The immutable archive passes parser (487), render (689), and layout (38) unit suites, golden_no_oracle, and clippy with warnings denied. The parity perturbation suite fails only on entry_exit_integer_thresholds and entry_exit_long_renamed_labels. The no-golden-data, frozen-comparator, decimal-ratchet, and error-census harness checks pass (the error census reports the golden submodule absent and skips its census body).

Audit of bdd66c28 found no fixture labels, corpus reads, golden embedding, include_str/include_bytes use, per-label/count ladders, or post-hoc SVG surgery. PhysicalFontMetricsExtract provenance agrees with the extracted Courier New metrics that motivated 49388ae2. The rejection is therefore not an overfit finding; it is that the generic replacement for Java's Svek/Graphviz table model is semantically incomplete.
